method: Each entry below was looked up on the issuing body's own catalogue page (ISO, IEC, ECSS, IAEA, NASA Technical Standards, HSE, EUR-Lex) on 2026-08-12 and the designation, title, issuing body and publication status were read off that page. The tool deliberately names documents without an edition year and states so in its own limitations, so what is graded is whether the designation itself is a live designation at the issuing body and whether the number, title and body agree. Where the issuing body's page could not be reached or did not state a status, the entry is recorded as unverified and is flagged rather than graded.
